title: Anti-Japanese Posters

page_data.en:
Fm. 2
G. 35m-11-32

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

File No. S. B. REGISTRY
D 4438
S.l., S.B. Station - A.3
Date January 25 33

Subject (in full) Anti-Japanese Posters

Made by/ and Forwarded by Superintendent Robertson

With reference to attached file, discreet observation
has been carried out at the Chen Tseng Tai Bookstore
(陳正泰), 482 Foochow Road, from where one of these
posters purports to emanate but no anti-Japanese or
otherwise objectionable pictures were on view. With
regard to two other posters attached, one emanates from
a publishing company in the city and the origin of
the other is not mentioned.

There is nothing to indicate that these posters
are of recent issue and it is possible that they are
part of a stock prepared during the local hostilities
of last year.

Jno Robertson
Superintendent

Officer i/c Special Branch.

发自 2
G. 35m-11-32

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

报告

档案编号 S. B. REGISTRY
D 4438
S.l., S.B. Station - A.3
日期 1933年1月25日

主题（全称）反日海报

由罗伯逊（Robertson）警司制作并呈报

关于所附档案，已在福州路482号陈正泰书店（陳正泰）进行了秘密观察，据称其中一张海报出自该处，但店内并未展示任何反日或其他令人反感之图片。至于另外两张所附海报，一张出自本市一家出版公司，另一张未注明出处。

没有任何迹象表明这些海报是近期印制的，它们可能是去年本地战事期间预备的库存的一部分。

约翰·罗伯逊（Jno Robertson）
警司

特别课主管警官。
